issue.title: Isolate xprompt usage tests from ambient swarm configuration
issue.description: Controlled full-suite benchmarking on 2026-08-05 found two deterministic baseline failures: tests/test_run_agent_runner_setup.py::test_preprocess_prompt_xprompts_captures_launch_boundary_usage and ::test_deferred_launch_xprompts_preserve_original_usage_metadata. Both also fail in a focused serial rerun because the live research_swarm xprompt is prepended to xprompts.json even though the tests patch their expected part/workflow catalogs; expected [plan] becomes [research_swarm, plan], and expected [gh, fork, beau, plan] gains research_swarm. No existing task or active epic covers this ambient swarm-catalog leak. Scope: isolate these tests from every ambient xprompt kind or inject a complete catalog dependency so assertions are independent of user configuration, while preserving coverage that pre-expansion usage metadata is captured.

payload.entry: Backlog triage 2026-08-06 (master 25285417d): re-ran both named tests in a focused serial run in workspace sase_13 with the live user configuration in place — '.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:randomly tests/test_run_agent_runner_setup.py::test_preprocess_prompt_xprompts_captures_launch_boundary_usage tests/test_run_agent_runner_setup.py::test_deferred_launch_xprompts_preserve_original_usage_metadata' → 2 passed in 2.33s. The bead's signature was a deterministic failure in exactly this configuration (expected [plan] becoming [research_swarm, plan]), so a clean serial pass is a direct refutation, not a flake-masked one. Either the research_swarm xprompt is no longer in the ambient catalog or the tests were since isolated. Closing as done rather than canceled because the reported failure no longer exists; +1 with a fresh failing run if ambient xprompt config leaks into these assertions again.

payload.close_reason: Verified no longer reproducing at master 25285417d; the ambient swarm-catalog leak this bead describes is gone.
